newsitem.title: GERMANY: German debt creeps higher, shakes off data.
newsitem.headline: German debt creeps higher, shakes off data.

text.p: German debt crept slightly higher in early trade on Wednesday as the market's mood appeared brighter after Bunds managed to shake off the possible negative impact from more robust international economic data.
"The market is looking pretty good this morning, especially after Bunds strengthened in active trading on Tuesday and there was little spillover from the U.S. or Japan," said a dealer.

By 0739 GMT the September Bund futures contract was trading up two basis points at 101.68, having traded between 101.71 and 101.54 since the opening. The benchmark 10-year cash bond was trading at 102.31 compared with its 102.29 close on Tuesday.

After showing resilience by climbing late Tuesday rather than falling through more support levels, Bunds managed to largely ignore a strong U.S. consumer confidence report which helped erase some gains in the Treasury market.
The German market also reacted with relative calm to the Bank of Japan's stronger than expected quarterly "tankan" survey which had battered the dollar and bonds.

Similarly two sets of German statistics data for June, state data from Hesse and preliminary West German price data for June, showing a 0.2 percent gain on the month and a 1.6 percent rise on the year, failed to hurt the market.

Although economists remarked that a slight uptick in German inflation rates and stronger M3 money supply growth should not be ignored, they said these numberes would likely not set off any warning bells at the Bundesbank yet.
"Right now the market is simply not willing to accept any sort of bad news," one dealer said, predicting Bunds would rather test higher than lower today.
Support at the 101.36 area is expected to hold and resistance is seen around 101.73.
Should the market break through the support levels, however, traders see more serious consequences.
"If prices drop and go through 101.09, we could quickly approach the psychologically key 101.00 level," added another dealer.
